_doc: MISUMI's post-assembly insertion spring nut (HNTP5) for its 5 series, 6 mm slot, M4. A ball on a spring presses on the slot's floor, so it stays put even in an upright beam. Hold: MISUMI gives no figure.
name: slot-nut-6-misumi-m4-roll-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 5 series (slot width 6 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M4, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

nut_kind.rule: Tipped in through the opening and rolled flat; a sprung ball holds it where it is put
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot: 17 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot: 8.3 on the drawing
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: 3.2 on the drawing (3.9 to the top of the tongue)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: the drawing's overall height less the body's
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Post-assembly insertion: put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

material.value: S10C equivalent steel with a SUS304 ball on an SWP-A spring, trivalent chromate
material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-563, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_563.pdf

hold.rule: Rexroth rates its swivel-in block with a spring at 2200 N in an 8 mm slot against 6000 N for its sliding block; the same share of the 6 mm sliding block's 3000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m4 thread set (ISO 898-1)
